rows.name: Merck & Co.
rows.thesis: Large pharma with +74% 12-1 month momentum, low volatility and a strong balance sheet. Health care is the best defensive sector this quarter (+12.5% over 3 months).
rows.risks: Patent-expiry worries for Keytruda and US drug-pricing policy could hurt the valuation.

rows.name: Nucor
rows.thesis: Steelmaker with +93% 12-1 month momentum and low volatility for its sector, helped by tariff protection and a conservative balance sheet.
rows.risks: Steel prices could weaken in an industrial slowdown.

rows.name: Targa Resources
rows.thesis: Pipeline company earning fee-based income from growing natural-gas volumes. It has near-high momentum (+91% 12-1 month) with only moderate volatility.
rows.risks: Commodity-linked volumes and its debt load could weigh on the shares if energy cools.

rows.name: Marathon Petroleum
rows.thesis: Leading refiner trading only 1% under its 52-week high, up 13% this month and 49% over 3 months as refining margins widen. Large share buybacks support the stock.
rows.risks: Refining margins could fall back quickly if demand weakens or supply rises.

rows.name: CrowdStrike
rows.thesis: Leader in endpoint security with growing recurring revenue. After this week's 17% drop it is a chance to buy a strong +102% 12-1 month trend that is still well above its 200-day average.
rows.risks: Its high valuation leaves the stock open to more falls if the tech selling continues.

rows.name: Fortinet
rows.thesis: Security company with good profitability and a firewall upgrade cycle, now 13% under its high after this week's drop.
rows.risks: Sales of its firewall hardware could slow down.

rows.name: Valero Energy
rows.thesis: A second refiner that benefits from the same margin conditions, with steady operations and strong cash returns to shareholders. I'm holding it smaller than MPC to limit how much I depend on one industry.
rows.risks: Heavy concentration with MPC if refining margins turn.

rows.name: NetApp
rows.thesis: Storage company with a cheaper valuation than other AI hardware, benefiting from demand for flash storage in data centers. It is +23% over 3 months even after this week's pullback.
rows.risks: Further selling of AI-hardware stocks could pull it lower.

rows.name: Illumina, Inc.
rows.thesis: Leader in gene sequencing whose results are recovering. The stock is +36% over 3 months and 54% above its 200-day average.
rows.risks: Its exposure to China and the volatility of its shares.

rows.name: DuPont
rows.thesis: DuPont after its split, now a more focused company in electronics and water. The stock is up 69% in 12 months and has moved only modestly in the past month, a calm way to own industrial exposure.
rows.risks: Problems from the split and legal liabilities from PFAS ('forever chemicals').

rows.name: Viatris
rows.thesis: Cheap generic-drug maker at a fresh 52-week high, with debt coming down and cash going back to shareholders.
rows.risks: Generic drug prices could fall, and it has a history of manufacturing and regulatory problems.

rows.name: Keysight Technologies
rows.thesis: Test-and-measurement company with improving orders across AI, wireless and defense customers, and +104% 12-1 month momentum.
rows.risks: Its order cycle could turn if semiconductor and telecom spending slows.

rows.name: Morgan Stanley
rows.thesis: Wealth-management franchise whose stock is 21% off its high. I'm making it a small position to add financials at a lower price.
rows.risks: Fewer deals and trading in a weaker market could keep the stock falling.
